svg.title: New 2-million-patient study, per 1,000 elective surgeries
svg.desc: Per 1,000 elective inpatient surgeries: major cardiovascular events 10 among GLP-1 users vs 11 among matched nonusers; infections 49 vs 53. Observational records study presented at ANESTHESIOLOGY 2026.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: “11% lower odds” is about 1 fewer heart event per 1,000 surgeries

svg.text: Observational: it can’t show the drug caused the gap. It didn’t establish whether or when doses were held,

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and didn’t report aspiration. Presented at a meeting; no peer-reviewed paper yet.
